summary_1line: Brahma explains the body and cosmos through the three gunas and elements, detailing the nature and consequences of the quality of Darkness.

image_candidates.scene_text: A symbolic human body depicted as a city with nine gates, ruled by understanding and threaded with three luminous channels representing the gunas.
Shadowy figures weighed down by darkness descend through realms, transforming into animals, serpents, and insects as a result of their deeds.
Three flowing streams—dark, fiery, and radiant—intertwine around the five elements, illustrating the interplay of Darkness, Passion, and Goodness.
